derived_monthly_summary.source_sha256_lineage_policy: Frozen original compressed 1d candidate SHA retained in 1mo source_sha256 field only after the decompressed 1d content anchor passed; reconstructed GZIP wrapper SHA is recorded separately.

limitations: This confirms decompressed candidate CSV content, schema, and row counts match the frozen verified snapshot anchors. A GZIP wrapper may have a different timestamp and therefore a different compressed SHA-256.

Monthly source ZIP byte hashes are measured from the cache; this task does not fetch monthly .CHECKSUM sidecars. The final candidate-content anchors must match exactly, including embedded source SHA-256 fields.
This task does not run CP-0031 or calculate any strategy/performance metrics; those belong to the next separately scoped diagnostic step.
